name: app-construction-progress-card-over-interior-photo
title: Dark progress card melting into a warm interior photograph
whatItIs: A dark vertical composition. At the top a charcoal rounded card reads 'CONSTRUCTION PROGRESS', 'Completed 75%', with a thin white progress bar; below, a photo of a sunlit beige living room fades upward into the black.
whatItMeans: Reassuring and premium; the fade makes data feel connected to the real space it describes.
techniques: Fade a photo into a dark background with a gradient so UI and image share one surface.
Show progress as a single hairline bar with large numerals.
Keep the card nearly the same tone as the background.
Use warm natural photography to soften a technical readout.

vocabulary.definition: An image dissolving into a solid colour with a gradient mask.
A compact card summarising one metric.
A card only slightly lighter than its background.
